scope: Same strict split; validation only; test not evaluated

feature_sets.global_176: 88 full-piece CQT-dB means + 88 full-piece population standard deviations
feature_sets.hard_windows_528: global_176 + elementwise mean and max of statistics from the top 20% 10-second overlapping windows ranked by mean positive adjacent-frame CQT-dB difference

interpretation: Hard-window pooling improves both models on this validation split. It supports the hypothesis that local CQT variation is useful, but does not prove generalization and is not equivalent to raw-audio rhythm features or a full sequence model.
